scope: A small auxiliary recall channel for zero-click long-tail ads; original main model and query encoder are retained

selection.development: Previously inspected old 10000-user validation cohort, evaluated with three reused main-model checkpoints; no new training
selection.eligibility: All-user fixed-budget evaluation: mean overall Recall500 retains at least 99% of same-main baseline, cold and clicked-tail Recall500 do not decrease, mean zero-click-tail Recall500 strictly increases, and at least two of three seed-specific models gain a zero-click-tail target
selection.primary: Among passing configurations maximize three-seed mean zero-click-tail Recall500
selection.ties: Then maximize mean overall Recall500, then prefer smaller quota, then raw_ip over cosine
selection.grid_limit: Only raw_ip/cosine crossed with quota1/quota5; no other score mode, quota, model, training or routing search
selection.failure: If no configuration passes, stop without opening the new confirmation targets
selection.confirmation: Lock score mode, quota, model identities and cohort before one three-model confirmation; do not reselect after confirmation
selection.confirmation_success: Apply the same point guards on confirmation: overall retention>=0.99, no cold or clicked-tail decrease, strictly positive mean zero-click-tail Recall500 gain, and at least two seed-specific models gain; report uncertainty separately and stop without retuning if these fail

inference.auxiliary_items: Original item encoder with only the explicit item-ID embedding contribution set to zero for eligible candidates; all original attributes and embedding81 remain
inference.raw_ip: Frozen original query dot auxiliary candidate vector
inference.cosine: Normalize query and auxiliary candidate vectors for this auxiliary channel only; main-channel scores and ranking stay raw inner product
inference.exclusions: Exclude padding, visible history and every main Top500 ID before selecting the 25 auxiliary proposals
inference.fusion: Protect main Top10 and every existing candidate with train-event frequency<=5; replace only tail positions of nonrare main candidates with novel eligible proposals, preserving exactly500 unique candidates
inference.quota: Maximum replacements per query; use fewer if fewer proposals or removable candidates exist
inference.routing: Apply the same rule to every user; eligibility and protection depend only on training counts and visible history, never on the held-out target

reporting.primary: Absolute zero-click-tail hit counts and Recall500, gains/losses, overall retention and per-model results
reporting.checks: Fixed500 unique IDs, no visible-history items, unchanged main Top10, preserved existing cold/tail candidates, aligned users/targets/model identities
reporting.uncertainty: Paired seed-model/user bootstrap intervals; point guards alone do not establish stable or significant improvement. Structural nonnegative rare-target differences can still have a zero lower confidence bound

limitations: Post-hoc feasibility quotas5/10/25 were previously inspected; this is a separately registered follow-up, not an untouched original hypothesis.
The three checkpoints are reused trained main models, not three newly trained auxiliary models or three independent user samples.
The explicit item-ID contribution is removed only in the auxiliary candidate view; the original high-cardinality attributes remain, so this is not a pure text-only encoder.
Cold and clicked-tail Recall500 preservation is structural, not evidence that the auxiliary channel learned to improve them.
Protecting Top10 means final Top10 metrics remain unchanged; this study concerns candidate coverage only.
No new training, network, ranking model or automatic replacement of the main model/index is introduced.
The confirmation cohort contains training-population users with previously unopened held-out behaviors; this is not new-user cold start or global-time production replay.
